## OSIRIS-REx’s Bennu Sample Totaled 121.6 Grams

OSIRIS-REx returned material from asteroid Bennu to Earth on September 24, 2023. The mission required at least 60 grams, and the team exceeded that amount before completely opening the sampling head.

A final pour added 51.2 grams, bringing the completed inventory to 121.6 grams.
